description: Sanity ecosystem presets, then Roboto policy LAST so it wins - preset packageRules are appended in order and the last matching rule sets each option.

packageRules.description: The Studio is held on the @sanity/ui v3 / @sanity/icons v3 line by sanity-plugin-lucide-icon-picker: 1.0.3 is its last release, and it imports Popover/Menu from the @sanity/ui root and TrashIcon/SyncIcon/EllipsisHorizontalIcon from the @sanity/icons root - all moved to subpaths in v4, so `sanity build` fails with MISSING_EXPORT the moment either crosses. Capped rather than disabled so fixes inside v3 still land. Lift both together when the plugin is replaced.

Held at 7 to match the catalog: next-sanity 13.3.3 imports `unstable__adapter`, which @sanity/client 8 removed, and next build dies loading next.config.ts. Lift when next-sanity ships a v8-compatible release.

Pinned exact in the catalog and apps/studio, so Renovate reads them as pins to keep current and would propose bumps. sanity is held at 6.9.1; @sanity/orderable-document-list 2.0.21+ imports DocumentVersionsStatusIndicator, which only sanity 6.11 exports, and @sanity/vision moves in lockstep with sanity. Drop when the catalog moves off 6.9.1.
